headline: Enugu Assembly caps rent hikes at 2%, landlords protest
summary: The Enugu State House of Assembly passed a bill regulating rent increases and reforming tenancy rules, with a provision limiting rent hikes to two per cent. Landlords have protested the measure.
why: Rent regulation changes the income outlook for property owners and the investment case for residential real estate in the affected state. Nigeria's property market is sensitive to such policy shifts.
